column1: # The intent manifest: what the specifications say each symbol's code must do,
# per shipped build, as ci/intent_comparator.py reads it against the
# requirement map. The map establishes what the code does; this says what it
# ought to do; the comparator derives the outcome and the action. Rows are
# drafted from the specifications and CONFORMANCE §8 (each cites its source)
# and approved by the owner through pull requests; the adversarial layer may
# challenge a row, never write one.
#   requirement  an MR-ID MASTER defines, or `-` when none explains the symbol
#   symbol       the canonical Rust path, as the map's defs.tsv names it
#   artifact     android | node (a symbol expected in both takes two rows)
#   root         the entry point that must reach it, or `-`
#   evidence     the tests that exercise it (`;` between), or `-`
#   exception    why, for an exclusion, a deprecation or a row with no requirement
#   cites        the spec clause or CONFORMANCE §8 row the intent comes from
